body.statement:
A proper convex function that is finite on a convex set is continuous,
relative to the affine hull of its domain, at every point in the relative
interior of that domain.

attestation.note: A stable book DOI and theorem number are supplied; no verbatim source text is reproduced.

body.justification: Finite convex and concave endpoint maps are continuous on the relative interior of their common domain.
body.gap: This theorem deliberately gives no relative-boundary continuity.
body.consumer: It is the continuity step in fixed-slope endpoint consistency.
